data.name: Mustala
data.gender_notes: Mustala is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who is tranquil, calm, and at peace with the world. The name Mustala carries the meaning “Tranquility, Calmness” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Mustala usually hope their child will grow to embody tranquility, calmness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those seeking inner peace and calmness in the chaos of the world
data.etymology: Mustala belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Tranquility, Calmness.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mustala total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: مستلا
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من استلاء على الشيء أي اقتدار عليه
in_arabic.long_meaning: مستلا هو اسم مشتق من الجذر العربي 'س-ت-ل' والذي يعني الاستيلاء على الشيء أو الاقتدار عليه. يوحي هذا الاسم بالقوة والسيطرة، وقد ورد في بعض التفاسير القرآنية ذات الصلة بالقوة والقدرة.

in_urdu.name: مستلا
in_urdu.meaning: وہ شخص جو کسی چیز پر اقتدار رکھتا ہو
in_urdu.long_meaning: مستلا نام عربی جڑ 'س-ت-ل' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے کسی چیز پر قابو پانا یا اس پر اقتدار رکھنا۔ یہ نام طاقت، اثر و رسوخ اور قابلیت کی علامت ہے، خاص طور پر جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی روایت میں۔

in_hindi.name: मुस्तला
in_hindi.meaning: जो किसी वस्तु पर अधिकार रखता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुस्तला नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी मूल 'س-ت-ल' से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है किसी वस्तु पर नियंत्रण या अधिकार रखना। यह नाम शक्ति, प्रभाव और क्षमता का प्रतीक है, खासकर भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में।

in_pashto.name: مستلا

in_english.name: Mustala
in_english.meaning: One who has power or control over something
in_english.long_meaning: The name Mustala originates from the Arabic root 'س-ت-ل' (s-t-l), which means to have power or control over something. This name signifies strength, authority, and capability. It has historical significance in Islamic tradition and is used across various Muslim cultures to denote someone with influential or dominant personality traits.

In Islamic culture, this name holds a special place as it reflects the ideals of patience, calmness, and composure maintained in the face of life's adversities. Mustalas are considered to be strong, resilient individuals who can overcome difficulties with grace and dignity.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Mustala signifies a deep connection with the Divine. It is believed that those who bear this name have been bestowed with a special strength and wisdom from Allah. They are encouraged to use this gift to help others find peace in their own lives and to spread the message of Allah's love and mercy. Additionally, the name serves as a constant reminder for them to maintain a state of tranquility and peace within themselves, as they continually seek to deepen their relationship with Allah.
